locations.note: Raiden infiltrates breakaway Abkhazia to stop Desperado's coup; the Chechen leader Dolzaev blows himself up on an oil tank.
In Guadalajara Raiden finds a research facility harvesting orphans' brains for cyborg soldiers and meets the boy George.
Raiden's one-man assault on World Marshal's headquarters in Denver, through the privatised city to fights with Monsoon and Sundowner.
At a Pakistani air base Raiden stops Senator Armstrong's plot to kill the US President, destroying Metal Gear EXCELSUS and beating Armstrong.

routes.name: Raiden
routes.note: Raiden's war on Desperado runs from Abkhazia through Guadalajara and Denver to the final fight with Armstrong in Pakistan.
